summary: Moved nudges from the Overview panel into a persistent navbar popover with shared polling and mark-read behavior, an accessible unread count, and a reduced-motion-safe attention cue.
risks: Manual browser verification of an unread nudge and mark-read clearing was not completed because no browser surface was available in this session.
The unfiltered repository-wide dotnet test run has two pre-existing Windows ProcessRunner timing failures even with Git sh available; all frontend checks and dotnet build pass.
